Description
Does your game crash every time you enter the Community Center?
This mod automatically detects and fixes corrupted bundle reward
data in your save file — the most common cause of this crash.
No save editing, no technical knowledge required.
Installation instructions
1. Install SMAPI
2. Extract the BundleFixer folder into your Mods folder
3. Launch the game through SMAPI
That's it — the mod works automatically on every save load.
Main features
- Automatically fixes non-numeric item IDs in bundle rewards
- Fixes lowercase type letters that cause crashes
- Works on any save file without manual editing
- Logs all fixes to the SMAPI console
Requirements
- SMAPI 3.0.0 or later
Shout outs
Thanks to the Stardew Valley community for helping identify this bug.
